_comment: Aelgard drop tables — Marstead itemization layer. This is the design bible for drops, NOT the runtime tables (those live in src/content/aelgard/monsters-mega.js and src/atoms/definitions/drop-tables.js, which the engine reads at boot). This JSON encodes: (a) the PHILOSOPHY — unique rare drops, reagent pairs, encounter-specific BiS — so the codex/narrator/slayer-master have a single source of truth; (b) the REAGENT GRAPH — which new-boss drops upgrade which old items, keeping old content alive (Marstead pillar 3); (c) encounter-specific BiS monsters (~10, like Arclight vs demons in OSRS).

_philosophy.pillar_4_non_degenerate: Every rare drop from monster X must be UNIQUE to X, or serve as a REAGENT that combines with other items to upgrade them. No 'generic rare sword' shared across 10 monsters. The item graph must be navigable as a design object.
_philosophy.pillar_3_old_content_alive: A new boss's reagent drop pairs with an OLD item to produce the upgrade. You cannot skip low-tier content by grinding high-tier bosses; the upgrade requires both. This is the 'reagent system.'
_philosophy.pillar_12_encounter_specific_BiS: ~10 monsters carry slayer-niche drops — weapons that are BiS only against that monster's tag. This prevents a single universal weapon from dominating PvE.
_philosophy.rarity_distribution_target: ~10% always / ~40% common / ~30% uncommon / ~15% rare / ~5% very_rare per monster. Collection-log uniques are independent rolls with 16-4096 denominator.
_philosophy.drop_weight_convention: weights sum to a clear denominator. 'Nothing' filler is explicit. Always drops have no weight (they are guaranteed).

low_tier_items_kept_alive_by_reagents: any_blade (chapel_ash x3 -> salted_blade — ALL TIERS kept relevant)

anti_degeneracy_verification.no_shared_rare_drops: Every rare-or-above drop is unique to its source monster OR is explicitly reagent-only (appears in multiple drop tables as a reagent, never as an equip).
anti_degeneracy_verification.tier_preservation: Reagent upgrades do not obsolete low-tier items — the low tier IS the reagent. Salted blade of bronze < salted blade of rune; but rune (baseline) < salted bronze vs vampyre.
anti_degeneracy_verification.BiS_is_niche_not_universal: 12 encounter-specific BiS weapons, each with a clearly bounded tag. No single weapon is BiS across all targets.

changes: Added 84 new drop tables for bestiary monsters (resolves C12 dangling refs). Bestiary coverage 30% -> 100%.
H9 rebalance: moved shared runes (blood/death/grimy_ranarr) OUT of 7 rare slots in legacy tables. Replaced each rare with a unique per-monster item (Pillar 4 compliance).
Each new rare slot is unique to its source monster per Marstead Pillar 4. Reagent pairs added where bestiary reagent_callout specified one.

H10: Added unique rare + pet drops for 16 bosses that previously had no coll-log unique. Targets: crystal_spider_queen, skotizo_moryskah, ToA wardens (3), fortress commanders (3), combat-challenge bosses (5), calamity_corruptor, grotto_mycelium, tos_verzik. 9 also carry reagent pairs producing slayer-niche BiS weapons.
